findings.title: Check Point Remote Access VPN CVE-2026-50751 (CVSS 9.3) — IKEv1 Certificate-Validation Bypass Actively Exploited Since 2026-05-07 By Qilin Ransomware Affiliate, CISA KEV-Added 2026-06-08 With Federal Deadline 2026-06-11 (Now Lapsed) — Affects 9 Branches R80.40 → R82.10 Plus Spark Firewalls
findings.affected_technology: Check Point Remote Access VPN, Mobile Access blade, and Spark Firewall product lines — affected branches R80.20.X, R80.40, R81, R81.10, R81.10.X, R81.20, R82, R82.00.X, R82.10 (four EoS: R80.20.X, R80.40, R81, R81.10) — logic flaw in how Remote Access and Mobile Access components validate certificates during IKEv1 key exchange; in deployments using deprecated IKEv1 + accepting legacy Remote Access clients + not requiring machine certificates, an unauthenticated attacker can establish a fully-authorised VPN session without any credentials; CISA added to KEV 2026-06-08 with a 3-day FCEB deadline of 2026-06-11 (now lapsed); Rapid7 MDR confirmed two customer incidents (high confidence) attributed to a Qilin ransomware affiliate using VPS infrastructure for geographically targeted ingress; Check Point first observed suspicious activity 2026-06-04 and traced the earliest exploitation to 2026-05-07; companion CVE-2026-50752 (CVSS 7.4) MITM on site-to-site VPN published in the same advisory, not exploited
findings.summary: Check Point Remote Access VPN CVE-2026-50751 (CVSS 9.3) IKEv1 certificate-validation bypass — actively exploited since 2026-05-07 by Qilin ransomware affiliate, KEV-added 2026-06-08 with federal deadline 2026-06-11 (now lapsed) — patch every R80.20.X–R82.10 gateway today, disable legacy Remote Access clients, force IKEv2-only authentication and require machine certificates on every external VPN.

findings.title: Oracle PeopleSoft PeopleTools 8.61/8.62 CVE-2026-35273 (CVSS 9.8) Now Assigned — Oracle Releases Emergency Mitigations 2026-06-11 For The Unauthenticated RCE That ShinyHunters Used To Breach 300 Instances Across 100+ Organisations; 68% Of Victims In Higher Education, Mandiant IOCs Published
findings.affected_technology: Oracle PeopleSoft Enterprise PeopleTools 8.61 and 8.62 — yesterday's Watchtower NEWS (titled 'Oracle PeopleSoft Mass-Extortion Campaign … gadget chain of old + zero-day') identified the ShinyHunters campaign with cve='Multiple'; Oracle has now assigned CVE-2026-35273 and confirmed the zero-day primitive is remotely exploitable without authentication and may result in remote code execution; Oracle released emergency mitigations via its support portal 2026-06-11 with a full patch forthcoming; Mandiant published recommendations including restricting access to sensitive PeopleSoft endpoints and monitoring for ShinyHunters TTPs (MeshCentral agents disguised as Microsoft Azure services, SSH brute-force against psoft / oracle / linuxadm accounts, azurenetfiles[.]net staging domain); scope refined to 68% higher-education concentration with Nottingham University (450K students) publicly confirmed; PT-Security dbugs PT-2026-48612 disclosure same day
findings.summary: Oracle PeopleSoft CVE-2026-35273 (CVSS 9.8 unauth RCE) — specific CVE now assigned and Oracle releases emergency mitigations 2026-06-11 for the ShinyHunters zero-day campaign newsed yesterday — score up 8→9, apply Oracle's portal mitigation immediately, restrict access to PeopleSoft endpoints, hunt for MeshCentral-as-Azure-service activity and azurenetfiles[.]net.

findings.summary: Ivanti Sentry CVE-2026-10520 active exploitation confirmed — Shadowserver 2026-06-11 reports 2/19 internet-exposed gateways already backdoored, < 48h after vendor advisory + watchTowr PoC; score holds at 9 — patch IMMEDIATELY to R10.5.2/R10.6.2/R10.7.1, IR-hunt every gateway you can reach for backdoor artefacts, treat unpatched perimeter Sentries as already compromised.

findings.title: Splunk Enterprise CVE-2026-20253 (CVSS 9.8) — Unauthenticated Arbitrary File Creation / Truncation Via PostgreSQL Sidecar Service Endpoint Lacking Auth Controls; Patched 2026-06-11 Alongside Three Additional Splunk High-Severity Issues (RCE / SSRF / XSS)
findings.affected_technology: Splunk Enterprise (specific version ranges pending vendor advisory transcription) — Splunk's PostgreSQL sidecar service exposes a file-operations endpoint that lacks authentication controls, allowing an unauthenticated attacker to invoke arbitrary file creation / truncation operations on the Splunk host (CWE-306 missing-authentication for critical function chaining to arbitrary file write → typical Splunk-RCE-via-app-deploy primitive); Splunk shipped fixes 2026-06-11 alongside three additional High-severity issues enabling RCE, SSRF, and XSS, plus four Medium issues touching saved-search modification and data exfil; SecurityWeek reports no observed in-the-wild exploitation yet; given Splunk's enterprise-wide deployment posture and its history (CVE-2024-32114 / multiple SPL-based RCEs) of becoming a ransomware-affiliate target within 30-60 days of high-CVSS unauth disclosures, this should be treated as a 7-14 day patch SLA on the indexer fleet
findings.summary: Splunk Enterprise CVE-2026-20253 (CVSS 9.8) — pre-auth arbitrary file creation/truncation via PostgreSQL sidecar endpoint missing auth controls, patched 2026-06-11 alongside RCE+SSRF+XSS — no in-wild yet, but Splunk's enterprise blast radius + history of post-disclosure ransomware-affiliate uptake warrants treating this as a 7-14 day patch SLA on every indexer.

findings.title: Veeam Backup & Replication v12 CVE-2026-44963 (CVSS 9.4) — Authenticated Domain-User RCE On Backup Server Patched 2026-06-09 In 12.3.2.4854 (Discovered By watchTowr's Sina Kheirkhah); Veeam v13 Architecture Not Affected
findings.affected_technology: Veeam Backup & Replication 12.3.2.4465 and all earlier v12 builds — authenticated domain-user RCE on the Backup Server; any AD-joined non-admin domain account suffices to obtain code execution on the Veeam server, which routinely holds backup-encryption keys + service credentials for every backed-up workload (a ransomware-affiliate dream-target); patched in 12.3.2.4854 (2026-06-09); v13.x architecture eliminated the vulnerable code path so v13 deployments are not affected; discovered + reported by watchTowr researcher Sina Kheirkhah, who has a multi-year track record of Veeam findings translating to ransomware affiliate weaponisation within 30-60 days (CVE-2023-27532 → Cuba/Akira; CVE-2024-40711 → Akira/LockBit; CVE-2025-23120 → Black Basta)
findings.summary: Veeam Backup & Replication v12 CVE-2026-44963 (CVSS 9.4) authenticated-domain-user RCE on backup server, patched in 12.3.2.4854 (watchTowr / Sina Kheirkhah) — Veeam's history of post-disclosure ransomware-affiliate uptake within 30-60 days means treat as 7-day patch SLA on every v12 deployment; v13 architecture is unaffected.

findings.title: Apache CXF 12-CVE Batch (oss-security 2026-06-11, Colm O hEigeartaigh) — OAuth2 Token-Introspection Auth Bypass + 7 OAuth2 Issues + 2 JNDI Injection (JMS / MDB) + XXE In W3CMultiSchemaFactory + Attachment-Header Restriction Gap — Affects Widely-Deployed Enterprise Java SOAP/REST Stack
findings.affected_technology: Apache CXF — widely-deployed enterprise Java SOAP/REST framework (downstream in Spring Web Services, ServiceMix, Karaf, JBoss Fuse, many Apache pipelines, and most large-enterprise Java service buses) — 12-CVE batch published 2026-06-11 via oss-security by Colm O hEigeartaigh: CVE-2026-49875 XXE in W3CMultiSchemaFactory and EndpointReferenceUtils; CVE-2026-50623 OAuth2 TokenIntrospectionService authentication bypass; CVE-2026-50627 OAuth2 Access Token Validator missing JWT audience/issuer validation; CVE-2026-50628 OAuth2 inverted IP-binding check defeats security control; CVE-2026-50629 OAuth2 log injection via unsanitised client identifier; CVE-2026-50630 OAuth2 HTTP response splitting via WWW-Authenticate realm injection; CVE-2026-50631 OAuth2 TOCTOU race condition in refresh-token processing; CVE-2026-50632 JNDI injection in JMSConfigFactory; CVE-2026-50633 JNDI injection in DispatchMDBMessageListenerImpl; CVE-2026-50634 WS JSON request filter trusts metadata from unvalidated first signature entry; CVE-2026-50645 no restriction on attachment headers per message — the OAuth2 auth-bypass (50623) + JNDI injections (50632/33) + XXE (49875) are the highest-impact items in scope for any internet-facing CXF deployment serving OAuth2 token endpoints or SOAP/JMS bridges
findings.summary: Apache CXF 12-CVE batch landed via oss-security 2026-06-11 — highest-impact items are CVE-2026-50623 OAuth2 token-introspection auth bypass, CVE-2026-50632/50633 JNDI injection in JMS handlers, and CVE-2026-49875 XXE in W3CMultiSchemaFactory; patch Apache CXF on every internet-facing SOAP / REST / OAuth2 surface in your Java estate today.

findings.title: protobuf.js 'Proto6' 6-CVE Batch — CVE-2026-44291 (CVSS 8.1) Prototype-Pollution Code-Gen RCE + CVE-2026-44295 (CVSS 8.7) Code Injection Via Malicious Schema Names + 4 DoS/Prototype-Pollution Issues; Affects Node.js Apps, Google Cloud Libraries, Baileys-Based WhatsApp Bots
findings.affected_technology: protobuf.js ≤ 7.5.5 and 8.0.0–8.0.1, plus protobufjs-cli ≤ 1.2.0 and 2.0.0–2.0.1 — the de-facto JavaScript/TypeScript Protocol Buffers implementation used in virtually every Node.js application that consumes gRPC, every Google Cloud client library, and the Baileys WhatsApp bot framework; 6-CVE 'Proto6' cluster comprises CVE-2026-44289 (CVSS 7.5 unbounded recursion DoS), CVE-2026-44290 (CVSS 7.5 process-crash via unsafe option paths), CVE-2026-44291 (CVSS 8.1 code-generation gadget triggered after prototype pollution → RCE), CVE-2026-44292 (CVSS 5.3 prototype injection in generated constructors), CVE-2026-44294 (CVSS 5.3 DoS via crafted field names), CVE-2026-44295 (CVSS 8.7 static code injection via malicious schema names); root pattern is treating schemas + metadata as trusted ('data becomes behavior'); patched in protobufjs 7.5.6 / 8.0.2 and protobufjs-cli 1.2.1 / 2.0.2; published attack scenarios include CI/CD pipeline poisoning leaking build secrets and crashing WhatsApp bot fleets via crafted messages
findings.summary: protobuf.js 6-CVE 'Proto6' batch — CVE-2026-44291 (CVSS 8.1 prototype-pollution → RCE), CVE-2026-44295 (CVSS 8.7 schema-name code injection), plus 4 DoS/injection issues; patched in 7.5.6 / 8.0.2 — audit every Node.js gRPC/Protobuf dependency tree, especially Google Cloud SDK consumers and Baileys-based bots.
